description: This PHP source file defines the BuzzPostShareAPI class, which serves as an API endpoint for managing 'share' data related to buzz posts within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving a list of shares for a specific post, with support for sorting and pagination, utilizing traits and models, and follows OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: BuzzPostShareAPI
classes.description: This class provides API endpoints for listing all shares of a specific post in the Buzz module, supporting pagination and sorting, following the collection endpoint pattern.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all shares of a specific post using the post ID, returning the share data and total count.
